method.route_vector: 10 denoise-step Hellinger distances, each averaged over 8 HB layers

aggregate.aggregation: equal weight per task for scalar means

association.scope: q0-q7, rank residualized within task x init-state x query
association.permutation: same flow-noise seed-column permutation shared by every task/state/query

failure_test.method: direct pair-weighted within-task/initial-state AUC; no fitted model
failure_test.permutation: two-sided 14-test maxT with one shared flow-noise seed-column permutation
